folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B153, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The full expanded plan and [method-use receipt](../gm/dispatch/foundation-method-use-2026-11-04/CHECKPOINT.md) were reviewed, including rounds 13-16 and final joined proof. The opening current-use pointer now reflects the receiving operation's completed scoped result rather than retaining its earlier active-writer status. Earlier blocked/in-progress passages remain dated history; they do not reserve files or undo the later explicit release. This review performed no runtime work (AD32, AD36).

Preserve the atlas's proper granularity: a donor mechanism can help before a whole world is complete, a second local law can revise the donor, and reuse leaves source, content, institutions, scale, interaction and proof costs. U/K coverage and E tables are explanatory, not a percentage or new build order. M8's lived texture can also be purely decorative under current DSG3/5/13; it need not manufacture a state consumer or reward. The Naruto/Witch Hat studies stay bounded attributed research and do not certify whole-source laws, exact transplant aftermath or general drawing/clone machinery (AD38, AD40, AD51).

M21/M22/M25 closes the selected Anna receiving chain on its named shortened entry, not every method, body, document, customer or payment system. Understood method, acquired source, reserve and the actual paper/retained knowledge remain separate. A copied/remembered adequate information route can work without its original paper; this slice adds no original-only law. Delivered advice reaches its real recipient while private observations remain private; the later fee is a separate consumer. Real UI ownership/dedup and data-driven narrator/catalog joins have final receipt evidence rather than inheriting earlier passes.

M19's support-at-boundary differs from continuous support; M20's refund/forfeit switch differs from mixed-stage consumption. M23 result sustain, M24 hung/missing/changed-source recovery and M26 different-law crossing remain unclosed by the method-use proof. The original transient-support and startup-wait qualifications remain useful. No full-world, ordinary-start, old-save migration, clean full-suite, installed-app or current primary-text verification is claimed.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B153, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The entire receipt, including failed probes, interim builds, shared UI join and final result, was read. The final joined result controls the earlier in-progress status and temporary writer hold. Preserve exact evidence accounting: 69 distinct focused cases combine the final affected 34-pass run with unchanged relevant checks; 33 browser assertions belong to the final named fixture/build. Prior successes do not certify the intermediate joined duplicate-reason failure or an upstream-arrival route.

The exact native document and restored optional catalogue are stronger evidence than a resource counter, while general forgery/copy semantics, lineage and all-world inventory restoration remain outside scope. Study creates the local understood readiness without converting every seen account into competence; source suppression/empty reserve affect execution without erasing retained learning. Recipient delivery and the existing fee are separate, and already-settled older observations are not retroactively rerun (AD32, AD36, AR6).

Data-driven narration and two catalogue consumers demonstrate a bounded seam, not a universal scripting engine. The direct-action writer's focus, quote and blocker association retain their own contribution and passed join. Both unrelated shared-pack changes and historical whole-window proof remain preserved rather than replaced by this fixture's hash. This reconciliation reran no test, build, browser, Import or private proof read; current lead order and the receipt's explicit general-divination/acquisition/support/recovery residue remain unchanged.
